purpose: one-way screen for violation of focal-cue exogeneity required by the fixed-D_eff theorem
ecological_question: Does the same local temperature cue used in the departure model also predict downstream transit compression more strongly where that cue has greater historical predictive connectivity to Bylot conditions?
unit: individual x origin route context x completed transition to the next frozen route context
primary_response: log transit_duration_days from departure of origin context to first entry into the next observed downstream frozen route context; skipped intermediate contexts remain valid compensation outcomes
primary_formula: log_transit_duration_days ~ local_temp_anom3 + local_temp_anom3:z_predictive_connectivity + z_wait_days + day_of_year_within_context + wind_support + precipitation + same_day_temp_anom + C(route_segment) + C(context_year_cell)
directional_prediction: negative; warmer cues are followed by shorter transit when those cues historically contain more information about later Bylot conditions
uncertainty: cluster-robust by individual; context-year fixed intercepts absorb all origin-context x year level mean differences; support additionally requires leave-one-context-year-out sign stability across at least 12 origin-context x year cells

secondary.formula: log_transit_duration_days ~ local_temp_anom3 * z_wait_days + local_temp_anom3:z_predictive_connectivity + z_wait_days:z_predictive_connectivity + local_temp_anom3:z_predictive_connectivity:z_wait_days + day_of_year_within_context + wind_support + precipitation + same_day_temp_anom + C(route_segment) + C(context_year_cell)
secondary.role: diagnostic that cue-linked transit compression strengthens after longer waiting; not required for primary classification

classification.supported: DUAL_USE_BEHAVIORAL_SIGNAL_SUPPORTED only if primary interaction <0, its individual-clustered 95% CI is entirely below 0, and every leave-one-context-year-out refit retains a negative interaction estimate

asymmetric_inference_rule: support blocks promotion of a cue-independent fixed-D_eff theorem for this focal cue; null does not establish exogeneity because no equivalence margin is prespecified
forbidden_reframings: do not call the transit-duration association direct observation of cue cognition
do not claim causal compensation from the observational screen
do not estimate D_eff from this screen
do not treat a null result as evidence that D_eff is cue-independent
do not change route segments, transit definition, q construction, or direction after outcome inspection

route_skip_secondary.response: skip_next_context = 1 when the next observed downstream frozen context is more than one route rank ahead
route_skip_secondary.formula: skip_next_context ~ local_temp_anom3 + local_temp_anom3:z_predictive_connectivity + z_wait_days + day_of_year_within_context + wind_support + precipitation + same_day_temp_anom + C(context_year_cell)
route_skip_secondary.role: secondary actuator diagnostic; route skipping is retained rather than excluded from the transit-duration analysis

preoutcome_amendment.issue: initial draft admitted only consecutive route-context transitions, which would discard route skipping even though skipping is itself a plausible compensation action
preoutcome_amendment.resolution: allow every forward transition among St_Lawrence, Nunavik, Baffin and Bylot; control primary transit-duration model by origin-destination route_segment; add route-skip secondary diagnostic

preoutcome_amendments.issue: predictive connectivity varies at the route-context x year level, so individual-clustered uncertainty alone could leave a supported interaction dependent on one context-year cell
preoutcome_amendments.resolution: require at least 12 context-year cells and require the registered interaction estimate to remain negative in every leave-one-context-year-out refit before classifying dual-use behavioral support

preoutcome_amendments.issue: predictive connectivity is constant within origin-context x year cells; route-segment plus year fixed effects do not fully absorb arbitrary context-year mean differences that could correlate with q
preoutcome_amendments.resolution: replace the q main-effect parameterization with context-year fixed intercepts and identify the focal local-temperature x q interaction from within-cell temperature variation and between-cell differences in temperature slopes; retain route-segment fixed effects for destination-distance heterogeneity
